items.claim: average() divides by len(prices) with no empty-list guard, so it raises ZeroDivisionError for an empty cart.
items.consequence: The PR description and the docstring both say carts are empty right after creation. average([]) evaluates total([]) / 0, which raises ZeroDivisionError. The new summary panel would crash for any freshly created cart. Return 0.0 (or None) for an empty list, or raise a clear domain error that the caller handles.
